name: Weekly ops sync
turns: Main topic today is the Riverside warehouse cutover. Decision for the record: we cut over to the new warehouse system on October 14.
That works for systems. The inventory migration script is written but not tested against real stock counts yet.
Then please own that. Can you have it tested on a copy of production inventory by October 3?
Yes. I will own the migration script test and report the mismatch count by October 3.
On the floor side, forty pickers need training on the new handheld scanners. I will run two training sessions before the cutover.

One more risk: the label printers. If the firmware is old, pick tickets might not print. I will check with the vendor.
Noted. Let us review all of this again next Monday.
